locator: p. 29, Consolidated Statements of Operations, FY2024 Products and Services net sales and cost of sales
p. 47, Note 13, net sales by country, FY2024
facts: China includes Hong Kong and Taiwan. U.S. is a country disclosure, not the Americas operating segment. The supplied country totals and Products/Services totals do not disclose their joint allocation.
FY2024 spans 52 weeks and ends September 28, 2024. These are annual net sales, not balances, customer counts or cash receipts.

locator: Authored stress scenario, not an issuer observation
facts: Authored sensitivity scenario, not an issuer forecast: allocate sales into nonnegative Products/Services by U.S., China (including Hong Kong and Taiwan), and other countries, preserving both sets of supplied totals. No other cross-cell constraints apply. The rates in stress_rates are percentage reductions of the relevant cell sales. Lost sales carry that business line's worldwide FY2024 gross margin in every geography. Beyond the cost-of-sales change implied by those margins, no secondary demand response, geographic switching or other profit changes occur. Gross profit here is sales less cost of sales. Optimize revenue and gross-profit loss separately over the same feasible allocations. Bounds are inclusive. The actual joint allocation is unknown.
